hints.title: Sign Assignment Subset Partition Obstacle
hints.text: Assigning '+' or '-' to every element to reach target splits nums into positive subset P and negative subset N. How can transforming P - N = target into finding a single subset sum simplify the problem?

hints.title: Subset Sum Mathematical Transformation Invariant
hints.text: Since sum(P) - sum(N) = target and sum(P) + sum(N) = total, adding them gives 2 * sum(P) = total + target. If total + target is negative or odd, 0 ways exist; otherwise find subsets summing to (total + target) / 2.

hints.title: 1D Subset Sum Reverse Accumulation Procedure
hints.text: Check if (total + target) is negative or odd; if so return 0. Set desired capacity s = (total + target) // 2. Initialize a 1D array of size s + 1 with entry 0 set to 1. For each number in nums, iterate backward from s down to num, adding entry j - num to entry j. Return entry s.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates through N numbers with backward scan over capacity S.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^N sign combinations causes exponential timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Compresses state space into a 1D array of length S + 1.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deriving the subset sum identity 2 * sum(P) = total + target.
